say:1:1033718001:1.text: Not every day... But as much as I can manage!
say:1:1033718001:1.source_cn: 也不算每天……但只要时间允许，我就会来这里！
say:1:1033718001:1.male: Not every day... But as much as I can manage!
say:1:1033718001:1.female: Not every day... But as much as I can manage!

say:2:1033718002:1.text: Mimily and I made a promise to play together again someday.
say:2:1033718002:1.source_cn: 米米丽当时和我约定好的，我们之后还要一起玩。
say:2:1033718002:1.male: Mimily and I made a promise to play together again someday.
say:2:1033718002:1.female: Mimily and I made a promise to play together again someday.

say:3:1033718003:1.text: I'm sure she'll be happy to see me waiting for her.
say:3:1033718003:1.source_cn: 如果她回来后见到我在信守承诺，她也会很开心吧！
say:3:1033718003:1.male: I'm sure she'll be happy to see me waiting for her.
say:3:1033718003:1.female: I'm sure she'll be happy to see me waiting for her.
